## Preval Growth

Preval Growth is an independent advertising service offered by Shawn Preval for elective care and medical travel. It is not a medical provider and does not arrange treatment.

Landing page: https://shawnpreval.org/medical-tourism-marketing/

### What the service does

Preval Growth helps clinics and medical travel companies run and track online advertising so they can see which campaigns lead to real conversations with prospective patients. Shawn manages Meta ads and Google Ads, connects inquiries to tracking, and shows clients where their advertising money is going.

Related search topics can include medical tourism marketing and cosmetic surgery advertising when that is the client’s focus.

### Audience

Clinics and medical travel companies. This can include cosmetic, dental, hair-restoration, fertility, and established medical-travel providers. It is not aimed at primary care, hospitals, urgent care, or every healthcare organization.

### Limitations

Shawn handles advertising and measurement, not medical advice or treatment arrangements. Preval Growth does not guarantee advertising or clinical outcomes.

### Contact

To request an advertising review, email ShawnPreval2020@outlook.com with the website, current advertising setup, and the biggest problem to solve.
